title.zh: 卷十一 本紀第十一: 章宗三
title.raw: 卷十一 本紀第十一: 章宗三 Volume 11 Annals 11: Zhangzong 3

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, new moon on jihai: the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the jihai new moon of the first spring month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，宋、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On xinchou Song and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Song and Western Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，諭有司：「凡館接伴並奉使者，毋以語言相勝，務存大體。

translations.literal: On guimao the relevant offices were instructed: “All lodging hosts and tribute-bearers alike must not try to outdo one another in speech; preserve the larger decorum.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the court told the relevant offices: “Hosts at the lodges and tribute-bearers alike must not try to win with words; keep to the larger decorum.

sentences.zh: 奉使者亦必得其人乃可。

translations.literal: Tribute envoys too must be men fit for the post before they may go.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute envoys too must be the right men before they are sent.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，詔罷講議所。

translations.literal: ” On yimao an edict abolished the Discussion Office.
translations.idiomatic: ” On yimao an edict abolished the Discussion Office.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，如城南春水。

translations.literal: On bingchen he went to the spring waters south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he went to the spring waters south of the city.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，並上京、東京兩路提刑司為一，提刑使、副兼安撫使、副，安撫專掌教習武事，毋令改其本俗。

translations.literal: On dingsi the Judicial Inspection Commissions of the Upper Capital and Eastern Capital routes were merged into one; the chief and vice judicial inspectors also served as pacification commissioners, with pacification charged solely with drill in martial affairs and not to let them alter their native customs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Judicial Inspection offices of the Upper Capital and Eastern Capital routes were merged; the chief and vice inspectors doubled as pacification commissioners, with pacification charged only to drill martial skills and not to let men abandon their native ways.

sentences.zh: 己未，以都南行宮名建春。

translations.literal: On jiwei the southern capital traveling palace was named Jianchun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the traveling palace at the southern capital was named Jianchun.

sentences.zh: 甲子，至自春水。

translations.literal: On jiazi he returned from the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he returned from the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，宋主以祖母喪，遣使告哀。

translations.literal: On yichou the Song ruler, in mourning for his grandmother, sent envoys to announce the bereavement.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Song emperor, mourning his grandmother, sent envoys to announce the death.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，以禮部尚書張暐為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Third month, on wuxu Minister of Rites Zhang Wei was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuxu, Minister of Rites Zhang Wei was made censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，復榷醋。

translations.literal: On renyin the vinegar monopoly was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the state vinegar monopoly was restored.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On jiayin he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，敕隨處盜賊，毋以強為竊，以多為少，以有為無。

translations.literal: On dingsi an order to all districts on bandits: do not treat armed robbery as petty theft, many victims as few, or existing crimes as none.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court ordered every district on bandits: do not call armed robbery theft, swell a crowd into a few, or treat real crimes as if they never were.

sentences.zh: 嘯聚三十人以上奏聞，違者杖百。

translations.literal: Bands of thirty or more must be reported; violators receive a hundred blows of the staff.
translations.idiomatic: Gangs of thirty or more must be reported at once; violators take a hundred blows of the staff.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，高麗王王皓以弟𧦬權國事，遣使奉表來告。

translations.literal: On bingyin the king of Goryeo, Wang Hao, had his younger brother 𧦬 administer state affairs and sent envoys with a memorial to report it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin King Wang Hao of Goryeo set his younger brother 𧦬 to govern in his stead and sent envoys with a memorial to report it.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌朔，諭有司：「宰相遇雨，可循殿廡出入。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on wuxu: the relevant offices were instructed: “When chancellors meet rain, they may pass through the side corridors.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the wuxu new moon, the court instructed: “When rain falls on chancellors, they may use the side corridors.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，諭御史台曰：「隨朝大小官雖有才能，率多苟簡，朕甚惡之，其察舉以聞。

translations.literal: ” On bingshen the Censorate was told: “Officials at court great and small may have talent, yet most are slipshod; I detest it—investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: ” On bingshen the Censorate was told: “Court officials great and small may have talent, yet most are careless and slack; I hate it—investigate and report.

sentences.zh: 提刑司所察廉能汙濫官，皆當殿奏，餘事可轉以聞。

translations.literal: Officials the Judicial Inspection finds honest or corrupt must all be memorialized in audience; other matters may be relayed through channels.
translations.idiomatic: Every honest or corrupt official the Judicial Inspection finds must be reported in audience; other matters may be relayed through channels.

sentences.zh: 」以侍御史孫俁為宣問高麗王王皓使。

translations.literal: ” Attending censor Sun Hou was made envoy to announce inquiry to Goryeo king Wang Hao.
translations.idiomatic: ” Attending Censor Sun Hou was made envoy to announce inquiry to King Wang Hao of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，右宣徽使張汝方以漏泄廷議，削官兩階。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on gengzi Right Xuanhui Commissioner Zhang Rufang, for leaking court deliberations, had two ranks of his office stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengzi, Right Xuanhui Commissioner Zhang Rufang, for leaking court deliberations, was stripped two ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，射柳、擊球，縱百姓觀。

translations.literal: On renyin willow-shooting and polo were held, and the common people were allowed to watch.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin willow-shooting and cuju were held, and the people were allowed to watch.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以客省使移剌郁為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On wushen Guest Reception Commissioner Yila Yu was made birthday envoy to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Guest Reception Commissioner Yila Yu was made birthday envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 甲子，參知政事楊伯通表乞致仕，不許。

translations.literal: On jiazi Participation Councillor Yang Botong memorialized begging to retire; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Participation Councillor Yang Botong asked to retire; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，幸香山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingwu he visited Fragrant Hill.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingwu, he visited Fragrant Hill.

sentences.zh: 己酉，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On jiyou he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，還宮。

translations.literal: On jiayin he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinwei he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinwei, he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，獵於香山。

translations.literal: On guiyou he hunted at Fragrant Hill.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he hunted at Fragrant Hill.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以護衛石和尚為押軍萬戶，率親軍八百人、武衛軍千六百人戍西北路。

translations.literal: On gengchen Palace Guard Shi Heshang was made army-escort commander of ten thousand households, leading eight hundred personal guards and sixteen hundred martial guard troops to garrison the Northwestern Route.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Palace Guard Shi Heshang was made escort commander of ten thousand households, leading eight hundred personal guards and sixteen hundred martial guard troops to garrison the Northwestern Route.

sentences.zh: 癸未，還宮。

translations.literal: On guiwei he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 宋遣使來報謝。

translations.literal: Song sent envoys to report thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Song sent envoys to return thanks.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申朔，天壽節，宋、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on bingshen, Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingshen new moon, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song and Western Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 以中都路都轉運使孫鐸等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: Central Capital Route chief transport commissioner Sun Tuo and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on its imperial birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Central Capital Route chief transport commissioner Sun Tuo and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On yisi he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，參知政事楊伯通再表乞致政，不許。

translations.literal: On gengxu Yang Botong again memorialized begging to leave office; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Yang Botong again asked to leave office; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 戊午，木波進馬。

translations.literal: On wuwu the Mubo presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Mubo presented horses.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengwu he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on gengwu, he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 癸未，行樞密院言斜出等請開榷場於轄裏嫋，從之。

translations.literal: On guiwei the acting Bureau of Military Affairs reported that Xiechu and others asked to open a monopoly market at Xialiniao; approved.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the acting Bureau of Military Affairs reported that Xiechu and others asked to open a monopoly market at Xialiniao; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，定官民存留見錢之數，設回易務，更立行用鈔法。

translations.literal: On dinghai fixed amounts of cash officials and commoners might keep on hand, established Exchange Offices, and issued new regulations for circulating notes.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the court fixed how much cash officials and commoners might keep, set up Exchange Offices, and reissued the law on circulating notes.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，樞密使兼平章政事襄至自軍，癸卯，以為尚書左丞相，監修國史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on dingyou Military Affairs Commissioner and concurrent Chief Councillor Xiang returned from the army; on guimao he was made Left Chancellor of the Secretariat and overseer of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingyou, Military Affairs Commissioner and concurrent Chief Councillor Xiang returned from the army; on guimao he was made Left Chancellor of the Secretariat and charged with compiling the National History.

sentences.zh: 丁未，乙太常卿楊庭筠等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On dingwei Grand Master of Sacrifices Yang Tingjun and others of grade yi were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Grand Master of Sacrifices Yang Tingjun and others of grade yi were sent to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔獎諭樞密副使夾穀衡以下將士。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict praised and instructed Deputy Military Affairs Commissioner Jiagu Heng and the officers and soldiers under him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict praised and exhorted Deputy Military Affairs Commissioner Jiagu Heng and the officers and soldiers under him.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，定屬托法。

translations.literal: On xinhai patronage law was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the law on patronage was fixed.

sentences.zh: 定軍前官吏賞格。

translations.literal: Reward scales for officials before the army were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Reward scales for officials serving before the army were fixed.

sentences.zh: 以邊事定，詔中外，減死罪，徒已下釋之。

translations.literal: With frontier affairs settled, an edict to court and realm commuted death sentences and released those sentenced to hard labor or below.
translations.idiomatic: With the frontier settled, an edict to court and realm commuted death sentences and released those sentenced to penal servitude or less.

sentences.zh: 賜左丞相襄以下將士金幣有差。

translations.literal: Left Chancellor Xiang and the officers and soldiers under him were granted gold and silks in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Left Chancellor Xiang and the officers and soldiers under him received graded gifts of gold and silks.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，冬獵。

translations.literal: On jiayin winter hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the winter hunt began.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子朔，獵于酸棗林。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on jiazi, hunted at Suanzao Grove.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiazi new moon, he hunted at Suanzao Grove.

sentences.zh: 大風寒，罷獵，凍死者五百餘人。

translations.literal: Great wind and cold; the hunt was abandoned; more than five hundred froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: A great cold wind blew; the hunt was called off, and more than five hundred people froze to death.

sentences.zh: 己巳，還都。

translations.literal: On jisi, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，尚書右丞嵒罷。

translations.literal: On bingxu Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Right Vice Director Yan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 高麗權國事王𧦬遣使奉表來告。

translations.literal: Goryeo regent Wang Xi sent envoys with a memorial to report.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xi, regent of Goryeo, sent envoys bearing a memorial to inform the court.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸巳朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, on guisi the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the guisi new moon of the first spring month, envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Xia came with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，尚書左董師中致仕。

translations.literal: On yisi Left Vice Director Dong Shizhong retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Left Vice Director Dong Shizhong retired.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，監察御史姬端修以妄言下吏。

translations.literal: On xinyou Supervising Censor Ji Duanxiu was handed to the authorities for reckless speech.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Supervising Censor Ji Duanxiu was arrested for reckless speech.

sentences.zh: 尚書左丞相襄為司空，職如故。

translations.literal: Left Chancellor Xiang was made Minister of Works, his duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Left Chancellor Xiang was named Minister of Works with his duties unchanged.

sentences.zh: 樞密副使夾谷衡為平章政事，封英國公。

translations.literal: Military Affairs Vice Commissioner Jiagu Heng was made grand councilor and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying State.
translations.idiomatic: Military Affairs Vice Commissioner Jiagu Heng became grand councilor and was enfeoffed as Duke of Ying State.

sentences.zh: 前知濟南府事張萬公起復為平章政事，封壽國公。

translations.literal: Former Jinan prefect Zhang Wangong was recalled to serve as grand councilor and enfeoffed as Duke of Shou State.
translations.idiomatic: Former Jinan prefect Zhang Wangong was recalled as grand councilor and enfeoffed as Duke of Shou State.

sentences.zh: 楊伯通為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Yang Botong was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Botong was appointed left vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 簽樞密院事完顏匡為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Affairs signatory Wanyan Kuang was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Military Affairs signatory Wanyan Kuang was made right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，如建春宮春水。

translations.literal: Second month, on yichou, went to the spring waters at Jianchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yichou, he went to the spring waters at Jianchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，還宮。

translations.literal: On jisi, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，御宣華門，觀迎佛。

translations.literal: On gengwu, at Xuanhua Gate watched the Buddha welcome procession.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he went to Xuanhua Gate to watch the Buddha welcome procession.

sentences.zh: 辛未，如建春宮。

translations.literal: On xinwei, went to Jianchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he went to Jianchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 赦姬端修罪，令居家俟命。

translations.literal: Ji Duanxiu’s offense was pardoned; he was ordered to remain at home awaiting orders.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Duanxiu was pardoned and ordered to remain at home awaiting further orders.

sentences.zh: 司空襄言，西南路招討使僕散揆治邊有功，召赴闕，以知興中府事紇石烈子仁代之。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Xiang said Southwest Route pacification commissioner Pusan Kuai had merit on the frontier and should be summoned to court; Heshenlie Ziren, acting prefect of Xingzhong, would replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Xiang reported that Southwest Route Pacification Commissioner Pusan Kuai had merit on the frontier and should be recalled; Heshenlie Ziren, administrator of Xingzhong, would replace him.

sentences.zh: 壬申，諭有司：「自三月一日為始，每旬三品至五品官各一人轉對，六品亦以次對。

translations.literal: On renshen he instructed the relevant offices: 「From the first day of the third month, each ten-day period one official of ranks three through five is to have a rotating audience, and rank-six officials likewise in turn.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he told the relevant offices: 「From the first day of the third month, each ten-day period one official of ranks three through five shall have a rotating audience, and rank-six officials likewise in succession.

sentences.zh: 台諫勿與，有應奏事，與轉對官相見，無面對者上章亦聽。

translations.literal: Censorate remonstrators are not to take part; where there are matters to memorialize, meet with the rotating-audience official; those without a face audience may also submit memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate remonstrators were excluded; where there were matters to report, they were to see the rotating-audience official, and those without a face audience might submit memorials.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，還宮。

translations.literal: 」On yihai, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: 」On yihai he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，如建春宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin, went to Jianchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he went to Jianchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上諭點檢司曰：「自蒲河至長河及細河以東，朕常所經行，官為和買其地，令百姓耕之，仍免其租稅。

translations.literal: On gengchen the emperor told the Inspection Office: 「From the Pu River to the Chang River and east of the Xi River, routes I often travel—the state shall purchase the land at fair price and let the people farm it, still exempting rent and tax.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the emperor told the Inspection Office: 「From the Pu River to the Chang River and east of the Xi River, along routes I often travel, the state shall buy the land fairly and let the people farm it, still exempting rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，還宮。

translations.literal: 」On jiashen, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiashen he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以西南路招討使僕散揆為參知政事。

translations.literal: On yiyou Southwest Route pacification commissioner Pusan Kuai was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Southwest Route Pacification Commissioner Pusan Kuai was made participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 起姬端修為太學博士。

translations.literal: Ji Duanxiu was recalled as Erudite of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Duanxiu was recalled as erudite of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 如建春宮。

translations.literal: Went to Jianchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He went to Jianchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，還宮。

translations.literal: On wuzi, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，同判大睦親府事宗浩為樞密使，封崇國公。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingyou, Concurrent Administrator of the Great Clanship Office Zong Hao was made military affairs commissioner and enfeoffed Duke of Chong State.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingyou, Concurrent Administrator of the Great Clanship Office Zong Hao was made military affairs commissioner and enfeoffed as Duke of Chong State.

sentences.zh: 己亥，如建春宮。

translations.literal: On jihai, went to Jianchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he went to Jianchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 遣使冊王𧦬為高麗國王。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to invest Wang Xi as king of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to invest Wang Xi as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書孫鐸、郎中李仲略、國子祭酒趙忱始轉對香閣。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Sun Duo, Director Li Zhonglue, and Guozijian Chancellor Zhao Chen began rotating audiences at the Incense Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Sun Duo, Director Li Zhonglue, and Guozijian Chancellor Zhao Chen began rotating audiences at the Incense Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 丁未，敕尚書：「官員必須改除者議之，其月日淺毋數改易。

translations.literal: On dingwei he ordered the Secretariat: 「Only when an officeholder must be transferred should it be discussed; where tenure has been brief, do not change posts repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he ordered the Secretariat: 「Transfers should be discussed only when necessary; where tenure has been brief, do not change posts repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，尚書省奏減親軍武衛軍額及太學女直、漢兒生員，罷小學官及外路教授。

translations.literal: 」On yimao the Secretariat memorialized to reduce the quotas of the Palace Guard and Martial Guard corps and of Jurchen and Han students in the Imperial Academy, and to abolish elementary-school officers and route-level instructors.
translations.idiomatic: 」On yimao the Secretariat asked to cut Palace Guard and Martial Guard quotas and Jurchen and Han students at the Imperial Academy, and to abolish elementary-school officers and route instructors.

sentences.zh: 詔學校仍舊，武衛軍額再議，餘報可。

translations.literal: An edict said schools should remain as before, Martial Guard quotas were to be debated again, and the rest was approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict kept schools as they were, sent Martial Guard quotas back for further debate, and approved the rest.

sentences.zh: 司空襄、右丞匡、參知政事揆請罷諸路提點刑獄，從之。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Xiang, Right Vice Director Kuang, and Participation Councillor Kuai asked to abolish route judicial intendant posts for punishment; the throne agreed.

translations.idiomatic: On wuwu hail fell.

translations.literal: On wuchen, went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he went to Wanning Palace.

translations.literal: On renshen Left Vice Director Yang Botong retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Left Vice Director Yang Botong retired.

translations.idiomatic: On renwu Prince Ying Congxian was promoted to Duke of Ying.

translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the relevant offices were ordered to perform outlook sacrifices at the marchmounts and watercourses for rain.

translations.idiomatic: second, farmers are strained by military levies;

translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat submitted a revised system for issuing tiger tallies and had it written into the ordinances.

translations.idiomatic: An edict issued the standard pattern for copper staves.

sentences.zh: 壬子，祈雨於太廟。

translations.idiomatic: On renzi rain was prayed for at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，更定軍功賞格。

translations.literal: On yimao the reward scale for military merit was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the military merit reward scale was revised.

sentences.zh: 戊午，司空襄以下再請御正殿，復常膳。

translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the rains being sufficient, thanks were reported at the altars of soil and grain.

translations.literal: On xinsi officers were sent to report thanks at the marchmounts and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi officers were sent to report thanks at the marchmounts and rivers.

translations.idiomatic: On renshen he hunted at Xiangshan.

translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, because no heir had been named, officials were ordered to pray at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

translations.literal: On dingchou he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he hunted in the near suburbs.

translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he returned to the palace.

translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, new moon on gengyin, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

translations.idiomatic: On jihai he went to Jizhou Autumn Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: Pusan Qi, administrator of Dongping prefecture, and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.

translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on bingyin, he returned from Autumn Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: On renwu leave for officials was first regulated.

translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Office for Reviewing Appointments was first established.

translations.literal: On gengxu officials were ordered to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu officials were ordered to pray for snow.

translations.idiomatic: Fan Ji, administrator of Jinan prefecture, and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.

translations.idiomatic: On xinyou regulations were revised for examining court-inspection clerks and legal specialists.

translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrator Yang Tingxiu asked that the sacred instructions of the Taizu, Taizong, and Shizong reigns be collected by category for regular reading.

translations.idiomatic: The court approved and also ordered Xizong added so the collection would cover four reigns.

translations.idiomatic: The National History Academy was given one additional Jurchen and one additional Han co-compiler of history.

translations.idiomatic: That month Pure Consort Li was advanced to Primary Consort.

translations.idiomatic: " On bingshen he went to the spring waters.

translations.literal: On xinsi the national betrothal and marriage rites were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi national betrothal and marriage rites were established.

translations.idiomatic: The former imperial-city meng'an in Shandong East Circuit was renamed Helige A'lin.

translations.idiomatic: The request was refused. On bingwu the Ministry of Revenue submitted the Commentary on the Laws.

translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yimao new moon, the court ruled that meng'an-mouke who killed in brawls and were spared execution would forfeit hereditary standing.

translations.idiomatic: Because the rains were ample, envoys were dispatched to report and offer sacrifice at the altars of soil and grain.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi standards were fixed for the archery examinations of policy-essay jinshi and hereditary appointees.

translations.literal: On wuwu an edict for the coming Double Fifth heaven-worship: those in public robes would keep the old bowing; all in informal dress would use the Jurchen bow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu an edict for the next Double Fifth heaven-worship ruled that those in court robes would keep the former bowing, while everyone in informal dress would use the Jurchen bow.

translations.literal: On jiwei an edict to circuit surveillance commissions to investigate local officials who beat people with heavy staffs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the court ordered circuit surveillance commissions to investigate local officials who flogged people with heavy staffs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，親王、文武百官、六學各上表請上尊號。

translations.literal: On yihai princes, civil and military officials, and the six academies each submitted memorials requesting an honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai princes, civil and military officials, and the six academies each memorialized asking for an honorific title.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: Refused.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，地震。

translations.literal: On gengchen there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an earthquake occurred.

sentences.zh: 詔定進納官有犯決斷法。

translations.literal: An edict fixed sentencing law for grain-purchase officeholders who committed offenses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established sentencing rules for grain-purchase officeholders who broke the law.

translations.literal: Sixth month, on yisi, relevant offices were sent to pray for clear weather and perform distance-sacrifice at mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yisi, officials were dispatched to pray for clear skies and offer distance-sacrifice at the marchmounts and rivers.

translations.literal: Seventh month, new moon on yimao: because skies had cleared, officials were sent for gaze-sacrifice at the marchmounts, guardian peaks, seas, and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the yimao new moon, with the weather clear, officials were dispatched for gaze-sacrifice at the marchmounts, territorial guardians, seas, and rivers.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，定居祖父母喪婚娶聽離法。

translations.literal: On guihai the law was fixed allowing divorce upon petition for marriage during mourning for grandparents.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai rules were set permitting divorce on petition when marriage had occurred during mourning for grandparents.

sentences.zh: 初置蒲思衍群牧。

translations.literal: The Pusiyan collective herd was first established.
translations.idiomatic: The Pusiyan collective herd office was established for the first time.

translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Participation Councillor Wangong Teci was granted two months’ leave of absence.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he hunted in the suburbs near the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he hunted in the near suburbs.

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renchen, he went to Fragrant Hill.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen, he went to Fragrant Hill.

sentences.zh: 乙未，至自香山。

translations.literal: On yiwei he returned from Fragrant Hill.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he returned from Fragrant Hill.

translations.idiomatic: On dingwei an edict on memorials from the Appointment Review Court allowed every officer of the court to enter the audience hall.

sentences.zh: 戊申，更定鎮防軍犯徒配役法。

translations.literal: On wushen the law on penal service for garrison-defense troops convicted of exile was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen sentencing for garrison-defense troops sentenced to penal exile was revised.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiayin new moon, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song and Goryeo sent envoys with congratulations.

translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Privy Council Commissioner Zonghao and Minister of Rites Jia Xuan were sent with gold tallies as provincial commissioners to survey land in Shandong and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 己未，尚書省奏：「西北路招討使獨吉思忠言，各路邊堡牆隍，西自坦舌，東至胡烈公，幾六百里，向以起築匆遽，並無女牆副堤。

translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Ministry of Revenue reported: "Northwest Route Pacification Commissioner Dusi Jizhong states that border forts and moats along each circuit, from Tanshe in the west to Huliegon in the east, nearly six hundred li, were first thrown up in haste without parapets or secondary embankments.

sentences.zh: 近令修完，計工七十五萬，止役戍軍，未嘗動民，今已畢功。

translations.idiomatic: He has lately been ordered to complete them; the project came to seven hundred fifty thousand units of labor, drawn only from frontier garrisons without levying the people, and is now finished.

translations.idiomatic: The revision of the Jade Registers was completed.

translations.idiomatic: On gengzi a dusty wind blew.

translations.idiomatic: Song sent an envoy to announce mourning.

translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he gathered officials at the Ministry of Revenue and asked: "There was drought not long ago, and lately the skies have long been overcast — might mistakes in policy have brought this about?"

sentences.zh: 」各以所見對。

translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he hunted in the near suburbs.

translations.idiomatic: On jisi Song again sent an envoy to announce mourning.

translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Right Deputy Palace Inspector Heseli Zhongding was sent to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.

translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renchen, the law on molded earthen tribute tea was abolished.

translations.literal: On dingwei he returned from the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he returned from the spring waters.

translations.literal: Third month, on yichou, Western Xia sent an envoy with thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yichou, Western Xia sent an envoy with thanks.

translations.idiomatic: On renshen he visited Tianchang Abbey.

translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he went to Wanning Palace.

translations.idiomatic: On yihai Song sent an envoy to return thanks.

translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the court revised the standards for retirement, release, and removal from registers among garrison-defense thousand-household mouke.

translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict required that government and private writing avoid the taboo minor characters of the temple names from the founding ancestor onward; offenders were punished according to law.

translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin, he played cuju at Linwu Hall and let the people of the capital watch without restriction.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，樞密使宗浩罷。

translations.literal: On bingchen Privy Council Commissioner Zonghao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Privy Council Commissioner Zonghao left office.

translations.literal: On renxu he went to Jade Spring Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he went to Jade Spring Mountain.

translations.literal: On wuyin the law allowing juniors to pursue and arrest guilty elders was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the statute permitting younger kin to pursue and seize guilty elders was repealed.

sentences.zh: 以直東上閣門劉頍為橫賜高麗使。

translations.idiomatic: Liu E, commissioner of the Straight Eastern Upper Inner Gate, was sent as Goryeo transverse-bestowal envoy.

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jimao, he went to Fragrant Hill.

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Participation Councillor Zhang Wangong requested retirement.

translations.literal: Not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused.

translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he prayed for rain at the northern suburbs.

translations.literal: Destroying trees was forbidden; selling land was punishable.
translations.idiomatic: Destroying trees was forbidden, and selling land was a punishable offense.

sentences.zh: 其田多汙萊，人戶闕乏，並坐所臨長吏。

translations.literal: Where fields were mostly waste marsh and households were deficient, the supervising local officials were also punished.
translations.idiomatic: Where fields lay mostly waste and households were short, the supervising local officials were punished as well.

sentences.zh: 按察司以時勸督，有故慢者量決罰之，仍減牛頭稅三之一。

translations.literal: The Inspection Commission was to urge and supervise in season; deliberate slackness was to be punished at discretion, and the ox-head tax was still reduced by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: The Inspection Commission was to urge and supervise on schedule; deliberate delay was to be punished at discretion, with the ox-head tax still cut by one-third.

sentences.zh: 敕尚書省舉行風俗奢僭之禁。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to enforce bans on extravagant and presumptuous customs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to enforce bans on extravagant and overreaching customs.

translations.literal: On dingwei an edict ordered the relevant offices to repair the lotus clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei an edict ordered the relevant offices to repair the lotus clepsydra.

sentences.zh: 甲子，諭刑部官，凡上書人言及宰相者不得申省。

translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he told officials of the Ministry of Punishments that petitions from letter-writers mentioning the chancellor must not be sent up to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，更定右選注縣令丞簿格。

translations.idiomatic: On yichou standards for right-route appointment to county magistrate, assistant, and registrar posts were revised.

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen, when a household died out one-third of its fields and houses was for the first time granted to daughters and granddaughters.

translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he returned from Wanning Palace.

translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Song sent envoys bearing thanks.

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a household-property survey in the Western Capital, Eastern Capital, and Liaodong circuits.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wushen new moon, Heavenly Longevity Festival, congratulatory envoys arrived from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.

translations.idiomatic: Rules for supporting schools and nurturing scholars were revised: licentiates received sixty mu per person of official land worked by commoners, with thirty shi of grain paid each year.

translations.idiomatic: Right Palatine Commissioner Tushan Huaiji and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday.

translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he went to Autumn Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he returned from Autumn Mountain.

translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on yiyou, he performed the collective ancestral rite at the Grand Temple.

translations.idiomatic: " On dingsi he told the Ministry of Works: "I have heard that oranges fruited in Huai prefecture; officials went to inspect and already harassed the people; now tangerines are being presented again — will that not harass them again?

translations.literal: "Let the offices be warned: present when there is something to offer, and stop when there is not.
translations.idiomatic: "Let the offices be warned: present when there is something to offer, and desist when there is not.

translations.idiomatic: " On gengshen Front Hall Right Guard general Heshilie Qijin and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 司空襄以下復請上尊號。

translations.literal: Sikong Xiang and those below again petitioned for an honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: Sikong Xiang and those below again asked for an honorific title.

translations.idiomatic: The court refused and also barred further memorials on the subject.

translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Sikong Xiang and others submitted fifty-two fascicles of the New Ordinances, Commands, Statutes, and Formats.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔頒行之。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict ordered them promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict ordered them promulgated.

translations.literal: On renyin he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he hunted in the near suburbs.

translations.literal: On yisi standards for promoting appointees marked incorrupt and capable were first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi standards for promoting officials marked incorrupt and capable were first established.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁未朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, new moon on dingwei: congratulatory envoys came from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.
translations.idiomatic: In year two, on the dingwei new moon of the first spring month, congratulatory envoys arrived from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，始朝獻于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On yimao Court Presentation was first performed at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Court Presentation was first performed at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸芳苑觀燈。

translations.literal: On gengshen he visited the Fragrant Garden to view lanterns.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he visited the Fragrant Garden to view lanterns.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，如建春宮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he went to the Jianchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he went to the Jianchun Palace.

translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuxu, honorary salary posts for palace eunuchs were first established.

translations.literal: On yisi he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he returned to the palace.

translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Chongdeng, Grand Preceptor and mother of Prince Cai Congyi, died; the court ordered the relevant offices to set mourning rites and burial ceremony, as recorded in Congyi's biography.

sentences.zh: 己亥，定遷三品官格。

translations.literal: On jihai regulations were set for relocating third-rank officials.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai regulations were fixed for posting third-rank officials.

sentences.zh: 複撲買河濼法。

translations.literal: The monopoly-purchase law for the He-liao marshes was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The state monopoly-purchase system for the He-liao marshes was restored.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，諭御史台，諸訴事於台，當以實上聞，不得輒稱察知。

translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he told the Censorate that every petition brought to it must be reported factually to the throne and that censors must not casually claim prior knowledge from investigation.

translations.literal: On guimao he went to the Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he went to the Wanning Palace.

translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices were ordered to pray for rain.

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on jiachen: the sun was eclipsed.

translations.idiomatic: On wushen he went to the Taihe Palace.

translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the first offering of new grain was presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

translations.idiomatic: On renxu he told the relevant offices: "The jin-well naboo lodges need not be kept up more than two or three days; for where I lodge, one cool pavilion is enough.

translations.idiomatic: Further repair and upkeep only waste labor for nothing.

sentences.zh: 其籓籬不急處，用圍幕可也。

translations.idiomatic: Where fencing is not urgent, curtained enclosures will do.

translations.idiomatic: " On jiazi the Taihe Palace was renamed Qingning and the Changle River was renamed Yunlong.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: Not granted.

translations.idiomatic: On yimao court-offering was performed at the Yansing Palace.

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the prince was enfeoffed as Prince Ge.

translations.idiomatic: Heshilie Yi, standby-duty general, was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy; Duji Wen, staff administrator of the Prince of Ying's prefecture, was sent as cross-bestowal envoy.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，更定德運為土，臘用辰。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiachen: the dynasty's Virtue Phase was revised to Earth, and the la sacrifice was set to use the chen cycle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, the dynasty's Virtue Phase was revised to Earth and the year-end la sacrifice was ordered to follow the chen cycle.

sentences.zh: 以西京留守宗浩為樞密使。

translations.literal: Western Capital defender-in-chief Zong Hao was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Hao, defender-in-chief of the Western Capital, was made military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以更定德運，詔中外。

translations.literal: On wushen, because the Virtue Phase had been revised, an edict was issued to court and country.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, because the Virtue Phase had been revised, an edict was sent throughout court and realm.

sentences.zh: 庚申，初命外官三品到任進表稱謝。

translations.literal: On gengshen it was first ordered that third-rank outer officials, on taking office, submit a memorial of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen it was first required that third-rank officials in outer posts submit a memorial of thanks on assuming office.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸玉虛觀，遣使報謝于太清宮。

translations.literal: On jiazi he visited the Jade Void Abbey and sent envoys to report thanks at the Grand Pure Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he visited the Jade Void Abbey and sent envoys to report thanks at the Grand Pure Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，以皇子晬日，放僧道戒牒三千。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on guiyou: on the prince's first full month, three thousand ordination certificates for monks and Daoists were issued.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiyou, on the prince's reaching his first full month, three thousand ordination certificates for monks and Daoists were granted.

sentences.zh: 以武安軍節度使徒單公弼等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Tu'an Gongbi, military commissioner of the Wu'an Army, and others were made Song New Year congratulatory envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Tu'an Gongbi, military commissioner of the Wu'an Army, and others were sent as Song New Year congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，冬獵。

translations.literal: On wuyin he held the winter hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he held the winter hunt.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，報謝于高禖。

translations.literal: On gengchen thanksgiving offerings were reported at the High Matchmaker shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen thanksgiving offerings were reported at the High Matchmaker shrine.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，還都。

translations.literal: On dingyou he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚戌，司空襄薨。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on gengxu: Sikong Xiang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengxu, Sikong Xiang died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，初命監察御史非特旨不許舉官。

translations.literal: On guichou it was first ordered that surveillance censors might not recommend officials unless by special edict.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou it was first ruled that surveillance censors might not nominate officials except by special edict.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遣使報謝於北嶽。

translations.literal: On xinyou envoys were sent to report thanks at the Northern Peak.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou envoys were sent to report thanks at the Northern Peak.

sentences.zh: 定人戶物力隨時推收法。

translations.literal: Regulations were set for the method of periodically reassessing and collecting household property capability.
translations.idiomatic: The court fixed a method for periodically reassessing household property liability and collecting the tax.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣使報謝於長白山。

translations.literal: On dingmao envoys were sent to report thanks at Changbai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao envoys were dispatched to offer thanksgiving at Changbai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 冬，無雪。

translations.literal: Winter: no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brought no snow.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛未朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, first month, new moon on xinwei: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, on the xinwei new moon of the first spring month, congratulatory envoys came from Song, Goryeo, and Xia.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遣官祈雪於北嶽。

translations.literal: On guiyou officials were sent to pray for snow at the North Marchmount.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou officials were dispatched to pray for snow at the North Marchmount.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，朝獻于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: On dingchou an offering audience was held at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he performed an offering audience at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以樞密使宗浩為尚書右丞相，右丞完顏匡為左丞，參知政事僕散揆為右丞，御史中丞孫即康、刑部尚書賈鉉並為參知政事。

translations.literal: On jimao Military Affairs Commissioner Zong Hao was made Minister of the Right and Grand Councilor; Right Vice Director Wanyan Kuang was made Left Vice Director; Participation Councillor Pusan Huai was made Right Vice Director; Censor-in-Chief Sun Jikang and Minister of Punishments Jia Xuan were both made participation councillors.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Military Affairs Commissioner Zong Hao became Minister of the Right and grand councilor; Right Vice Director Wanyan Kuang became left vice director; Participation Councillor Pusan Huai became right vice director; and Censor-in-Chief Sun Jikang and Minister of Punishments Jia Xuan both became participation councillors.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，如建春宮。

translations.literal: On gengchen he went to Jianchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he went to Jianchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，還宮。

translations.literal: Second month, on guichou, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，定諸職官省親拜墓給假例。

translations.literal: On jiazi regulations were set on leave grants for officials visiting kin and sweeping tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the court fixed rules on leave for officials making family visits and tomb observances.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，平章政事張萬公致仕。

translations.literal: Third month, on renshen, Grand Councillor Zhang Wangong retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renshen, Grand Councillor Zhang Wangong retired from office.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，如萬甯宮。

translations.literal: On gengchen he went to Wanning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he went to Wanning Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，定從人銅牌賣毀罪賞制。

translations.literal: On dinghai regulations were set on crimes and rewards for selling or destroying followers’ copper tallies.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the court fixed penalties and rewards for selling or destroying the copper tallies of followers.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，定職官應遷三品格，刺史以上及隨朝資歷在刺史以上身故者，每半年一次敷奏。

translations.literal: On gengyin regulations were set for officials eligible for third-grade promotion; for prefects and above, and for those at court with prefect-level seniority who died in office, reports were to be presented in audience every half year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin rules were fixed for officials due for third-grade promotion, and for prefects and above and court officials of prefect-level standing who died in office—each case was to be reported in audience every six months.

sentences.zh: 甲午，如玉泉山。

translations.literal: On jiawu he went to Jade Spring Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he went to Jade Spring Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以殿前都點檢僕散端為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On bingshen Palace Commandant Pusan Duan was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Palace Commandant Pusan Duan was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 四月乙巳，禘於太廟。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on yisi, the di offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yisi, the di offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 敕點檢司：「致仕官入宮，年高艱於步履者，並聽策杖，仍令舍人護衛扶之。

translations.literal: An edict to the Inspection Office: “Retired officials who enter the palace and, being advanced in years, find walking difficult may all use staves, and palace stewards are to escort and support them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the Inspection Office: “Retired officials entering the palace who are elderly and have difficulty walking may all use staves, and palace stewards are to escort and support them.

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，敕有司祈雨，仍頒土龍法。

translations.literal: ” On dingsi the relevant offices were ordered to pray for rain, and the earth-dragon method was issued.
translations.idiomatic: ” On dingsi the relevant offices were ordered to pray for rain, and the earth-dragon rain charm was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 己未，命吏部侍郎李炳、國子司業蒙括仁本、知登聞檢院喬宇等再詳定《儀禮》。

translations.literal: On jiwei Vice Minister of Personnel Li Bing, Guozijian Vice Chancellor Mengkuo Renben, Director of the Petitions and Memorials Inspection Court Qiao Yu, and others were ordered to revise the Rites again in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Vice Minister of Personnel Li Bing, Guozijian Vice Chancellor Mengkuo Renben, Director of the Petitions and Memorials Inspection Court Qiao Yu, and others were ordered to revise the Rites of Zhou again in detail.

sentences.zh: 庚申，諭省司：「宮中所用物，如民間難得，勿強市之。

translations.literal: On gengshen he instructed the ministries: “Palace goods that are hard to obtain among the people are not to be forcibly purchased.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he told the ministries: “Goods used in the palace that are scarce among the people must not be forcibly bought up.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，尚書省奏，遣官分路覆實御史所察事。

translations.literal: ” On guihai the Secretariat memorialized dispatching officials on each route to verify matters the censors had investigated.
translations.idiomatic: ” On guihai the Secretariat reported dispatching officials on each route to verify the cases the censors had investigated.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，以重五，拜天，射柳，上三發三中。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renshen, for Double Fifth he worshipped Heaven and shot at the willow; the emperor shot three times and hit three times.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renshen, for Double Fifth he worshipped Heaven and shot at the willow; the emperor fired three arrows and hit three times.

sentences.zh: 四品以上官侍宴魚藻殿。

translations.literal: Officials of fourth rank and above attended the banquet at Fish-and-Weeds Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of fourth rank and above attended the banquet in Fish-and-Weeds Hall.

sentences.zh: 以天氣方暑，命兵士甲者釋之。

translations.literal: Because the weather was hot, soldiers in armor were ordered to remove it.
translations.idiomatic: Because the weather was hot, armored soldiers were ordered to take off their armor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以定律令、正土德、鳳凰來、皇嗣建，大赦。

translations.literal: On bingxu a general amnesty was proclaimed for fixing the statutes, rectifying the earth virtue, the phoenix’s coming, and establishing the imperial heir.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu a general amnesty was proclaimed for codifying the laws, affirming the earth virtue, the arrival of the phoenix, and the establishment of the imperial heir.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，皇子葛王薨。

translations.literal: On xinmao Prince Ge died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Prince Ge died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，定擅增減宮門鎖鑰罪。

translations.literal: On renchen penalties were set for unauthorized addition or removal of palace-gate locks and keys.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen penalties were fixed for anyone who added to or reduced palace-gate locks and keys without authorization.

sentences.zh: 丙申，作太極宮。

translations.literal: On bingshen Taiji Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Taiji Palace was built.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jihai, Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jihai, Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔選聰明方正之士為修起居注。

translations.literal: On renyin an edict ordered selection of men of talent and integrity as compilers of the daily records.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict ordered men of talent and integrity to be chosen as compilers of the court diary.

sentences.zh: 又詰點檢司，諸親軍所設教授及授業人若干，其為教何法，通大義者幾人，各具以聞。

translations.literal: The Inspection Office was also questioned: how many instructors and students were set up in the various kin armies, what methods they taught, and how many grasped the larger meaning—each was to report fully.
translations.idiomatic: The Inspection Office was also questioned on how many instructors and pupils the kin armies had appointed, what their teaching methods were, and how many understood the larger principles—each was to report in full.

sentences.zh: 戊申，定職官追贈法，惟嘗犯贓罪者不在追贈之列。

translations.literal: On wushen regulations on posthumous honors for officials were set; only those who had committed graft were excluded.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen rules on posthumous honors for officials were fixed; only those who had ever committed graft were barred.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣官行視中都田禾雨澤分數。

translations.literal: On renxu officials were sent to inspect capital-region crops and report rainfall levels.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu officials were dispatched to inspect crops in the central capital region and report how much rain each district had received.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，朝獻于衍慶宮。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on renshen, an offering audience was held at Yanqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renshen, he performed an offering audience at Yanqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，定大臣薨百官奉慰禮。

translations.literal: On yihai condolence rites were fixed for when grand ministers died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai rules were set for the court condolence rites when grand ministers died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On gengchen he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上諭宰臣：「凡奏事，朕欲徐思或如己者，若除授事，可俟三五日再奏，餘並二十日奏之。」

translations.literal: On dinghai the emperor told the chief ministers: “Whenever you memorialize, if I wish to think it over slowly or if it concerns me personally, and if it is an appointment matter, you may wait three to five days and memorialize again; all other matters are to be reported within twenty days.”
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor told the chief ministers: “When you submit memorials, if I want time to reflect or if the matter touches me personally, and if it is an appointment, you may wait three to five days and submit again; everything else is to be reported within twenty days.”

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，還宮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingchen, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingchen, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命編修官左容充宮教，賜銀、幣。

translations.literal: On gengshen compiler Zuo Rong was appointed palace tutor and given silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen compiler Zuo Rong was made palace tutor and granted silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅朔，天壽節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on bingyin, Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingyin new moon, the Heavenly Longevity Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以刑部尚書承暉等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: On renshen Minister of Punishments Cheng Hui and others were made envoys for Song’s imperial birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Minister of Punishments Cheng Hui and others were sent as envoys for Song’s imperial birthday.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以萬甯宮提舉司隸工部。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Wanning Palace oversight office was placed under the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Wanning Palace oversight office was placed under the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔定千戶謀克受隨處捕盜官公移，盜急，不即以眾應之者罪有差。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict fixed that thousand-household mouke were to accept official orders from local bandit-catchers, with graded penalties if they failed to respond promptly with their men in urgent cases.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict ruled that thousand-household mouke must obey official orders from local bandit-catchers, with graded penalties if they did not muster their men promptly in urgent cases.

sentences.zh: 召右丞相宗浩還朝。

translations.literal: Right Grand Councilor Zong Hao was recalled to court.
translations.idiomatic: Right Grand Councilor Zong Hao was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，日將暮，赤如赭。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu, as the sun was setting it turned red as cinnabar.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on wuxu, as the sun was setting it turned red as cinnabar.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大風。

translations.literal: On jihai there was a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai a great wind blew.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，申、酉間天大赤，夜將旦亦如之。

translations.literal: On jiachen, between shen and you the sky turned great red; toward dawn it was the same.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, between the shen and you hours the sky turned deep red; the same held as night neared dawn.

sentences.zh: 壬子，右丞僕散揆至自北邊，丙辰，召至香閣慰勞之。

translations.literal: On renzi Right Vice Director Pusan Huai arrived from the northern frontier; on bingchen he was summoned to the Incense Pavilion and comforted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Right Vice Director Pusan Huai arrived from the northern frontier; on bingchen he was summoned to the Incense Pavilion and given words of comfort.

sentences.zh: 以尚食局使師孝為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: Imperial Kitchen Bureau commissioner Shixiao was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Kitchen Bureau commissioner Shixiao was sent as Goryeo birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 庚申，尚書左丞完顏匡等進《世宗實錄》。

translations.literal: On gengshen Left Vice Director Wanyan Kuang and others presented the Veritable Records of Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Left Vice Director Wanyan Kuang and others presented the Veritable Records of Shizong.

sentences.zh: 上降座，立受之。

translations.literal: The emperor left the throne and received them standing.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stepped down from the throne and received them standing.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以薊州刺史完顏太平為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On renxu Jizhou Prefect Wanyan Taiping was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Wanyan Taiping, prefect of Jizhou, was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 奉御完顏阿魯帶以使宋還，言宋權臣韓侂胄市馬厲兵，將謀北侵。

translations.literal: Attendant Wanyan Aludai, returning from an embassy to Song, reported that Song’s powerful minister Han Tuozhou was buying horses and drilling troops and planned a northern invasion.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Wanyan Aludai, back from an embassy to Song, reported that Song’s powerful minister Han Tuozhou was buying horses, sharpening arms, and plotting a northern invasion.

sentences.zh: 上怒，以為生事，笞之五十，出為彰德府判官。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry, deemed it troublemaking, had him flogged fifty blows, and sent him out as judge of Zhangde prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious, took it as stirring up trouble, had him flogged fifty strokes, and sent him out as administrator of Zhangde prefecture.

sentences.zh: 及淮平陷，乃擢為安國軍節度副使。

translations.literal: When Huai Ping fell, he was promoted to deputy military commissioner of the Anguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: When Huai Ping fell, he was promoted to deputy military commissioner of the Anguo Army.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，諭尚書省：「士庶陳言皆從所司以聞，自今可悉令詣闕，量與食直，仍給官居之。

translations.literal: On dingmao he instructed the Secretariat: “Commoners’ proposals should all pass through the relevant offices for report; from now on they may all come directly to the palace gates, be given food and compensation according to measure, and be provided official lodging.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he told the Secretariat: “Petitions from commoners should still go through the relevant offices, but from now on they may all come directly to the palace gates, be given food and travel pay as appropriate, and be lodged in official quarters.

sentences.zh: 其言切直及系利害重者，並三日內奏聞。」

translations.literal: Those whose words are blunt and straightforward or concern major benefit and harm are all to be memorialized within three days.”
translations.idiomatic: Those whose words are blunt or bear on major public interest are all to be reported to me within three days.”

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，以簽樞密院事獨吉思忠等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinwei, Privy Council signatory Dusigusi Zhong and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Privy Council signatory Dusigusi Zhong and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，冬獵，以獲兔，薦山陵。

translations.literal: On dingchou, on the winter hunt, rabbits taken were offered at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, during the winter hunt, rabbits taken were offered at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔監察等察事可二年一出。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict ruled that surveillance investigations could rotate out every two years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict ruled that surveillance investigations could be rotated every two years.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，諭宰臣曰：「賀正宋使且至，可令監察隨之，以為常。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengzi, he told the chief ministers: “The congratulatory envoys for Song New Year are about to arrive; you may have the censors accompany them as a standing rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengzi, he told the chief ministers: “The Song envoys coming for New Year congratulations are about to arrive; let the censors accompany them, and make this the regular practice.

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，還都。

translations.literal: ” On renyin he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: ” On renyin he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賜天長觀額為太極宮。

translations.literal: On jiyou Tianchang Abbey was granted the plaque-name Taiji Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Tianchang Abbey was granted the plaque-name Taiji Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔諸親王、公主每歲寒食、十月朔聽朝謁興、裕二陵，忌辰亦如之。

translations.literal: On xinhai an edict ruled that princes and princesses each year on Cold Food and the tenth-month new moon might pay court at the tombs of Xing and Yu, and on death anniversaries as well.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict allowed princes and princesses each year on Cold Food and the tenth-month new moon to attend court at the tombs of Xing and Yu, and likewise on death anniversaries.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔遣監察御史分按諸路，所遣者女直人，即以漢人朝臣偕，所遣者漢人，即以女直朝臣偕。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict dispatched surveillance censors to tour the circuits; if the envoy was Jurchen, a Han courtier was to accompany him, and if the envoy was Han, a Jurchen courtier was to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict sent surveillance censors on circuit tours; Jurchen investigators were paired with Han courtiers, and Han investigators with Jurchen courtiers.

sentences.zh: 戊午，敕行宮名曰光春，其朝殿曰蘭皋，寢殿曰輝寧。

translations.literal: On wuwu the travelling palace was named Guangchun, its audience hall Langan, and its sleeping hall Huining.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the travelling palace was named Guangchun, its audience hall Langan, and its sleeping hall Huining.
